mapper.select:
select v.id, v.name, v.address, v.description, v.cover_object_key as cover_url, min(stt.sale_price) as minimum_price from venue v join admission_session s on s.venue_id = v.id join session_ticket_type stt on stt.session_id = s.id join ticket_type tt on tt.id = stt.ticket_type_id where v.status = 'ENABLED' and s.status = 'OPEN' and s.booking_start_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP and s.booking_end_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP and s.remaining_capacity > 0 and stt.status = 'ON_SALE' and stt.remaining_quantity > 0 and tt.status = 'ENABLED'
and (v.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or v.address like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
group by v.id, v.name, v.address, v.description, v.cover_object_key order by min(s.visit_date), v.id
select id, name, address, description, cover_object_key as cover_url from venue where id = #{venueId} and status = 'ENABLED'

select s.id as session_id, s.visit_date, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.booking_end_at, s.remaining_capacity, stt.id as session_ticket_type_id, tt.name as ticket_type_name, tt.description as ticket_type_description, tt.audience_rule, stt.sale_price, stt.remaining_quantity from admission_session s join venue v on v.id = s.venue_id join session_ticket_type stt on stt.session_id = s.id join ticket_type tt on tt.id = stt.ticket_type_id where s.venue_id = #{venueId} and s.visit_date = #{visitDate} and v.status = 'ENABLED' and s.status = 'OPEN' and s.booking_start_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP and s.booking_end_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP and s.remaining_capacity > 0 and stt.status = 'ON_SALE' and stt.remaining_quantity > 0 and tt.status = 'ENABLED' order by s.start_time, stt.id

select s.id from admission_session s
join venue v on v.id = s.venue_id
where s.venue_id = #{venueId} and s.visit_date = #{visitDate} and v.status = 'ENABLED' and s.status = 'OPEN' and s.booking_end_at > #{now}
and exists ( select 1 from session_ticket_type stt join ticket_type tt on tt.id = stt.ticket_type_id where stt.session_id = s.id and stt.status = 'ON_SALE' and tt.status = 'ENABLED' )
order by s.start_time, s.id
